decision_gate: Treat extra-step benefit as meaningful for a next-stage target only if pooled paired success has at least 4 wins and at most 1 loss against 1 step, with wins across at least 2 perturbation categories. Otherwise stop.
fixed_model: Frozen official pi05_libero checkpoint plus frozen long_3000_20260930 residual head; no head influence on steps.
hardware: Run model with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3, physical UUID GPU-4779cdde-a260-f8ec-da6a-6fa390bc7fd7; simulator uses CPU osmesa.
initial_noise: Per instance and action-chunk NumPy PCG64 key derived from SHA256 of suite, task name, episode seed, chunk index; standard normal float32 shape [50,32]. Shared across flow arms.
latency: Wall-clock synchronized model request time per action chunk, and end-to-end episode wall time including simulator; p50/p95 chunk latency.
name: libero_plus_pi05_no_training_pilot_v1
primary_outcome: closed-loop success from env done within 220 policy steps after 10 dummy steps
primary_pairing: exact task instance and episode seed; compare each n=2,4,10 to n=1, and all arms descriptively
protocol_amendment: After the separate smoke and first six pilot episodes, identical-input probing found a first-pass log-sigma difference of about 0.0039 between 1-step and multi-step compiled traces despite exact observation and noise digests. Task IDs, seeds, step arms, and outcomes were unchanged. This amendment adds exact observation hashing and a conservative 0.01 log-sigma numerical tolerance; the full paired pilot is restarted in a new result file.
score_analysis: First-chunk sigma ranking of paired success gain; report AUROC only if both gain and nongain cases exist, with task-cluster bootstrap interval.
score_summary: Canonical score: first Euler velocity evaluation at t=1 of the first action chunk in the 1-step arm. Other arms log same-pass sigma; their first observations, noise and init state must match exactly and first log sigma must be within 0.01 of the canonical score to allow bfloat16 schedule-specific arithmetic.
uncertainty: Paired discordant counts and exact Clopper-Pearson interval for win fraction; category results descriptive because each has four instances.
